tagline: An offline dictionary that helps you learn words
intro: LibreDict is a fast, lightweight dictionary for English, Greek, Spanish, Russian and Arabic. Look a word up, then learn it.
description: LibreDict: an offline dictionary for iPhone and iPad that helps you learn words. No ads, no accounts, no tracking.

blocks.p: English is included; other languages download once and then work offline. Search finds any inflected form (έγραψα finds γράφω), and Greek words show declension and conjugation tables.
Word lists by level (Greek A1–B1, English A1–C2) or your own from CSV, Anki or Quizlet. Daily practice with spaced repetition and real example sentences.
A conjugation drill and short grammar topics, with Greek as the first language.
No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.

shots: A word with its conjugation table

p: Nothing. The app has no analytics, no ads, no accounts and no identifiers. Your history, My words, learning progress and statistics stay on your device.

When you ask for a language, the app downloads public files from GitHub Releases. As for any download, GitHub receives your IP address and the system user agent, under [GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). Nothing identifies you to LibreDict.
Only when you tap it. The Mail app shows you the whole message, including the app and iOS versions, before you send it.
The reminder is a local notification on your device. Nothing is sent to a server.
It sets no cookies, loads nothing from other servers and counts no visits.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Write to {email}{telegram}. In the app you can also report a bug: Settings → Support → Report a Bug.

faq.a: English is included. Every other language downloads once, when you choose it, and then works offline.
In My words, in the Learn tab, once you have chosen a language to learn. They are the same words.
